name: ExitGuard — Pre-Trade Safety Oracles
description: Executable exit-liquidity, rug-in-progress detection & escape curve for Solana/EVM tokens. Pre-trade safety for AI trading agents. x402/USDC.
longDescription: 8 keyless pay-per-call oracles that answer what a trading agent must know BEFORE it buys: can I get back out, and is the exit drying up right now? escape-curve measures the max USD size a token stays sellable (executable round-trip at rising sizes); liquidity-decay detects a rug in progress via the time-derivative of executable exit. Plus solana-gate GO/NO-GO, exit-check, on-chain rug check, survival-score (forward-measured AUC 0.718), Hyperliquid funding-carry, and pre-sign drainer/hook audit. Measures the executable exit, not the quoted price — 97% of fresh tokens can't be sold at size.
